messages:
amanda.chen: Quick sync — sprint slice proposal for Customer Gamma upgrades. I sketched 3 upgrade lanes and a minimal E2E checklist. Need ops + field input before we lock scope.
riya.patel: sounds good. can you list the lanes?
amanda.chen: Lane A: in-place rolling with lightweight schema checks (target for low-risk customers). Lane B: phased blue-green with traffic cutover (for high-availability customers). Lane C: offline agent + staged data migration (air-gapped / restricted networks).
jordan_lee: Lane C will need an explicit installer checksum + deterministic DB migrations. field teams asked for a revert path without DB revert if possible.
luis.moreno: +1. Also we need to capture network constraints: some customers can't open outbound, so Lane C must support tarball install + local artifact registry.
amanda.chen: noted. Acceptance criteria idea: 1) automated smoke tests pass within maintenance window, 2) rollback verified within 30m, 3) IP/peering preserved OR documented migration steps.
riya.patel: For Lane A, define SLOs: <200ms median API latency during upgrade, <1% error budget consumed. How do we measure during cutover?
jordan_lee: Use canary traffic slice + traffic mirroring. We should add a Prometheus dashboard and a synthetic scenario: `upgrade-e2e/smoke.yaml` that runs post-deploy checks.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please attach runbook ticket before scheduling maintenance window. Ticket template: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/upgrade-template
luis.moreno: Field ask: customers want calendar lead time + exact IP ranges. Can we include an auto-generated IP diff in the release artifacts?
amanda.chen: good call. We'll add an artifact `network-change.json` per build with allowed CIDR list and port mapping.
riya.patel: Prioritization question: do we allocate one backend eng for Lane C this sprint, or push into next? Lane C looks higher effort (offline packaging + security approval).
amanda.chen: Proposal: move Lane A->B into current sprint (0.5 FTE infra + 1 FE) and schedule Lane C as a focused spike next sprint (2 engineers, security consult).
anjordan_lee: spelling: s/anjordan/jordan_lee/ (sorry).
jordan_lee: For rollout automation, we should add an `--preflight-only` flag to the installer so field can validate without changing state. Example: `./installer --preflight-only --config customer-gamma.yaml`.
luis.moreno: Customer ask: retention of old KV caches for 24h to mitigate model cold starts post-upgrade. Can we support TTL-based cache handoff?
amanda.chen: we'll include a cache-handoff step in the runbook: snapshot KV, warm caches on new nodes, then switch traffic. Add to acceptance criteria.
riya.patel: Tests: integration suite must run against a full-network emulation for Lane C (no outbound). We need to create a lightweight local registry image and fixture.
jordan_lee: I'll open two PRs: one for `upgrade-lanes/acceptance.md` and one for the `installer --preflight-only` patch. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: New ticket created: PROD-7421 Upgrade lanes acceptance + runbook. Assigned: amanda.chen, jordan_lee. Due: 1712550000.
luis.moreno: Once PRs land, can we schedule a 30min field demo with Customer Gamma next week? They requested walkthrough.
amanda.chen: Yes — let's aim for Tue 10am PT. I'll ping calendar after PRs are green. :calendar:
riya.patel: Final note: document rollback metrics we will track (error rate, 95th latency, token cost deltas). Put them in the PR checklist.
amanda.chen: thanks all. I'll update the RFC and attach the artifacts. Meeting notes -> https://notes.redwood/upgrade-lanes-gamma (draft). :thumbsup:
